title: 5 signs your phone is why you're always tired
format: Notes listicle, app on one point
why: Variant of 52 (1K views): same self-diagnosis listicle, new angle; app is the fix on the last sign.
caption: which one got you? #sleep #screentime #tired
check: closer: 'i was 5/5'. Only if true for you

slides.title: 5 signs your phone is why you're always tired

slides.heading: you wake up _already tired_
slides.top: 8 hours in bed, maybe _5 of them asleep_
slides.text:
the rest went to _"just checking"_

your body was in bed. your brain was _on tiktok_

slides.heading: you need _3 coffees_ to feel normal
slides.top: one to wake up, one to function, one _because it's 3pm_
slides.text:
caffeine isn't fixing a sleep problem

it's _covering_ one

slides.heading: you fall asleep _mid-video_
slides.text:
that's not falling asleep

that's _passing out_

slides.heading: your eyes _sting_ when you put it down
slides.top: you finally lock it and the room is _darker than you remember_
slides.text:
you stared at a light for 3 hours

and wonder why sleep _won't come_

slides.heading: you _know_ all this and still scroll
slides.text:
so i stopped relying on it

my apps _go to sleep at bedtime_ now and don't open till morning

slides.question: how many are you? 👇
lines: the app is locturne, it's on the App Store
